name: API Usage Overview
description: Organization and environment API usage across Novu regions. Filter by org ID, compare regional traffic, and detect endpoint spikes.

variables.name: environmentId
variables.title: Novu environment ID (optional, use % for all)

pages.name: Overview
pages.description: API request volume by organization over time

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId TIMESERIES 1 hour LIMIT 15

pages.name: By organization
pages.description: Endpoint breakdown for a selected org and Novu environment

rawConfiguration.text:
## Organization drill-down

Set **Organization ID** in the filter bar to inspect a single customer. Leave blank to see the top orgs across all regions.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET appName TIMESERIES 1 hour

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms', percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET name LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests', average(duration) AS 'Avg ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND name LIKE '%events/trigger%' AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName, name LIMIT 50

pages.name: Spikes
pages.description: Detect org/endpoint traffic spikes vs the previous period

rawConfiguration.text:
## Spike detection

Tables compare **last hour vs same hour yesterday**. Line charts compare **today vs one week ago**. Look for orgs with large positive deltas on specific endpoints.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId, appName, name SINCE 1 hour ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago LIMIT 100

SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND name LIKE '%events/trigger%' AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId, environmentId, appName, name SINCE 1 hour ago COMPARE WITH 1 day ago LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Regional throughput today vs last week

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET appName TIMESERIES SINCE today COMPARE WITH 1 week ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE '% - API' AND organizationId IS NOT NULL AND name LIKE '%events/trigger%' AND organizationId LIKE {{organizationId}} AND environmentId LIKE {{environmentId}} AND appName LIKE {{region}} FACET organizationId TIMESERIES 15 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 10
